slides.title: Open your invite
slides.html:
Open the invite link or scan the QR code you got. Deploy App opens with your invite code filled in.

  • Only got a code? Type it in Enter your code and press Login with Code.

slides.title: Choose your callsign
slides.html:
Type a callsign your unit knows you by and press Continue.

  • You use the same callsign in every service.
  • It is also your certificate password.

slides.title: Get approved
slides.html:
An admin has to approve you.

  • Admin next to you: show them the QR code.
  • Admin somewhere else: press Copy link and paste it into a message to your admin.
  • Leave the page open. It moves on by itself once you are approved.

slides.title: Get your key
slides.html:
Press Download key. The key is a file you install on this Mac.

  • Safari asks the first time. Press Allow.

slides.title: Install the key
slides.html:
1. Open the downloaded file.
  2. Unlock with Touch ID or your Mac password.
  3. Enter your callsign as the password and press OK.

Keychain Access opens. Come back to the browser and press Installed – continue.

slides.title: Keychain: open the certificate
slides.html:
In Keychain Access:

  1. Choose My Certificates.
  2. Search for your callsign. ⌘V pastes it.
  3. Double-click your callsign row.

The certificate only shows up after you search for it. Press Done – next.

slides.title: Keychain: trust the certificate
slides.html:
1. Open Trust.
  2. Set When using this certificate to Always Trust.
  3. Close the window and confirm with Touch ID or your password.

Press Done – next.

slides.title: Keychain: allow use of the key
slides.html:
1. Open the arrow left of your callsign row.
  2. Double-click Imported Private Key.
  3. Choose Access Control.
  4. Select Allow all applications to access this item.
  5. Press Save Changes. Enter your Mac password (not Touch ID) and press Allow.
  6. Close the window and Keychain Access.

Press Ready – continue.

slides.title: Go to the service
slides.html:
Press Go to the service. Select your callsign and press OK.

  • If your Mac asks for a password, enter your Mac password and choose Always Allow.
  • In Safari, press Go to the service, then Login with Certificate. Select your callsign and press Continue.

slides.title: You're in
slides.html:
Deploy App opens. A short guide shows the first time. Press Next to go through it, or close it.

  • Tick Do not show me guides automatically if you don't want guides to pop up.
